coreModelUse: Start with two observation sources, make an identity-aware dated table, then compare changes without calling any difference an intruder.

sections.why: Named read-only task and comparison model.
sections.pressure: The page’s one task must be the first thing seen.
rejected: text: buries the task in a paragraph

sections.why: Router sees clients, owned host sees sockets; neither is the complete inventory.
sections.pressure: Two incomplete views must be held side by side, not in sequence.
rejected: text: two views in prose blur into one list

sections.why: Two-column sample avoids losing identity evidence at phone width.
sections.pressure: Phone width; identity evidence must stay attached to each row.
rejected: text: sample records in prose are hard to scan

sections.why: Show address rotation versus unexplained device in a small before/after table.
sections.pressure: Before/after must compare in parallel rows.
rejected: diagram: rotation vs unknown is a state comparison, not a flow

sections.why: A bounded procedure to gather, corroborate, save and revisit.
sections.pressure: Gather → corroborate → save → revisit is an order; prose hides it.
rejected: text: a procedure in prose hides the order

sections.why: Reader rehearses one record; explicitly temporary, not persistent storage.
sections.pressure: The reader must rehearse one record themselves, not just read about it.
rejected: checklist: rehearsing a record is not a tick-off task

sections.why: Transfer: a changed IP is a question, not an intrusion verdict.
sections.pressure: Transfer needs a scored case the page didn’t walk through.
rejected: fill-in: an open blank can’t test the transfer; it needs a right answer

sections.pressure: Claims about consumer guidance need linkable sources.

notUsed.why: No scan is needed for the lesson or authorized scope.
